input_domain: float32 RGB in [0,1] after the frozen 248-short-side bicubic antialiased resize and 224x224 center crop, before mean/std normalization

geometry_backend_contract.implementation: torchvision.transforms.functional operations pinned by recovery-v2 environment torchvision 0.17.2; Y1 must byte-bind the implementation adapter
geometry_backend_contract.coordinate_convention: zero-based pixel-center coordinates y,x on 224x224; source-to-transformed forward map is recorded for every condition
geometry_backend_contract.map_inverse_interpolation: bilinear for rotations; exact index permutation for flip and translation
geometry_backend_contract.valid_mask: transport a source-support image of ones while treating every synthetic fill or reflection-pad value as support zero, apply the frozen inverse operator, and mark valid iff returned support >= 0.999999; thus translate_x_-8 is clean-domain columns 8..223, translate_x_8 is columns 0..215, flip/photometric/noise are full-domain, and rotation uses the exact bilinear support mask rather than a hand-picked rectangle
geometry_backend_contract.patch_matrix_inverse: construct W[clean_patch,transformed_patch] by lifting each transformed patch as uniform pixel mass 1/256, applying the frozen inverse map, and sum-pooling clean 16x16 patches; inverse matrix is W @ T_transformed @ W.T and inverse CLS vector is W @ C_transformed; only fully valid source/destination patch pairs enter agreement

noise_seed_rule: uint64_big_endian(first_8_bytes(SHA256('STAGE_Y_NOISE_V1_20260910' + NUL + source_object_id + NUL + condition_id))) with numpy.random.PCG64
